sources_considered.why: Reproduces a dated founding-period email explicitly considering a commercial corporation alongside a nonprofit.
Establishes the adopted public model, but cannot establish every option privately envisioned.
Reports discussions about reduced openness, but the extracted passage does not date the underlying exchange sufficiently to establish founding-period intent.

evidence_items.locator: November 2015 section; reproduced November 20, 2015 email from Musk to Altman

receipt.public_excerpt: a standard C corp with a parallel nonprofit.

evidence_items.explanation: A commercial corporation alongside a nonprofit was explicitly contemplated during founding discussions. This undercuts the claim about wholly unforeseen commercialization, but does not establish anticipation of all three later changes Marcus identifies.

unresolved_gaps: The inspected founding records do not establish whether the particular later changes to openness and financial-return commitments were originally contemplated.
A proposed corporate alternative is not conclusive evidence about the founders' adopted mission or expected future changes to it.
The correspondence is reproduced by a party to the dispute; this assessment did not independently authenticate the original email.
